newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: EuroAirport double-digit growth in cargo traffic.
newsitem.headline: EuroAirport double-digit growth in cargo traffic.

text.p: Global cargo traffic handled at Basle-Mulhouse-Freiburg airport, in the first seven months of 1996, totalled 50,834 tonnes, a 14 percent rise on the same period last year, airport authority figures show.
January-July 1996 airfreight traffic handled at the airport, officially known as EuroAirport, totalled 28,016 tonnes, an increase of 32 percent on 1995 levels.
In the past 18 months, full-freighter services have been launched to Chicago, Atlanta, Delhi, Seoul and Istanbul.
Later this month, Swissair said it will launch a weekly DC10-30 freighter service between and Sao Paulo.
January-July 1996 trucked airfreight traffic fell by two percent on last year's levels to 22,816 tonnes.
Postal traffic handled at the frontier airport totalled 1,976 tonnes, up 10 percent on the first seven months of 1995. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
